_saturation_definition: closed-loop actuator saturation: |actuator_force| >= 0.98 * actuator_forcerange upper bound, fraction of 29 actuators, per control step (tools/g1_clip44_gate.py rollout()). NOT the open-loop tau/limit > 1.0 definition of tools/n1_knee_id.py, and NOT the SONIC definition. The three are not interchangeable.

fixed_window.definition: supported: t < 2.0 s; fall: 2.2 s <= t <= 3.0 s (hard-coded constants, matching the shipped artifact's keys)

contact_derived_window.definition: support-loss onset = earliest alive step from which the foot-contact duty cycle over the next 0.2 s stays < 0.5 until termination; supported: steps before onset; fall: onset .. onset + 0.6 s, clipped at termination

not_recoverable_from_this_artifact: which actuators saturate (the papers say 'wrists, waist'): g1_clip44_gate.py reduces over the actuator axis with .mean(dim=1) before storing, so per-actuator identity is absent from the .npz. Verifying that phrase requires a new GPU rollout.
a landing/touchdown contact event: every replicate terminates while root_z is still decreasing, so the data contain no post-airborne landing contact.
